title: Googlebook is perfect for me
body: As someone who uses her laptop for simple and various day-to-day activities such as browsing the web, watching TV, completing homework, and a bit of gaming, this laptop is great! It's sleek and minimalistic, making it very straightforward to do all of those things. That being said, I can understand why people are unhappy. Being the first line of Googlebooks, at very daunting price, the incompatibility with many apps, typical convenience features, and outside devices is both somewhat expected and simultaneously disappointing. Similarly, its ability to support specialized software for gaming, art, etc. is lacking. I do not recommend this laptop to anyone who intends to use it excessively or with high expectations for the software it can support, but if you're looking for a daily laptop for general use, it will certainly fulfill your needs. With that in mind, there are much cheaper options available that will do just as much. Personally, aside from the price, I am very pleased with my Googlebook and look forward to its future generations.
